questions.stem: An element has the electron configuration 2, 8, 8, 2. What period and group is it in?
questions.explanation: The number of electron shells gives the period (4 shells = Period 4) and the number of outer shell electrons gives the group (2 outer electrons = Group 2). This element is calcium.

questions.stem: Group 0 elements (noble gases) are described as unreactive. Why is this?

options.text: Because they have full outer electron shells
Because they are all gases at room temperature
Because they have the same number of protons and neutrons

questions.explanation: Noble gases have full outer electron shells (8 electrons, or 2 for helium). Since they already have a stable electron arrangement, they do not need to gain, lose, or share electrons, making them very unreactive.
